content.title: Tower Semiconductor posts upbeat revenue forecasts on data-center boom, shares rise
content.summary: Israeli contract chipmaker Tower Semiconductor on Monday forecast fourth-​quarter revenue above estimates, banking on strong demand for its ‌chips used in data centers and AI infrastructure, sending its U.S.-‌listed shares up 15%. The shares hit their highest in more than two decades following the results, after surging 63.2% this year. The company expects quarterly revenue of $440 million, plus or minus 5%⁠, compared with ‌analysts' average estimate of $434.4 million, according to data compiled by LSEG.
